customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to operate with a user-friendly app and appreciate its premium build quality and top-tier security features. They like its appearance, with one customer noting there's no ugly handle sticking out, and another mentioning the high-tech face unlock feature. While customers consider it a good value, opinions about installation time are mixed.

reviews.author: shivaditya
reviews.title: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed
reviews.body: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed Bought the Native Lock Ultra about three weeks ago and I'm genuinely impressed. The build quality feels premium; heavy-duty and solid, nothing like the flimsy locks I've tried before. The auto-lock feature is my favourite — I no longer have to second-guess whether I locked the door before leaving. The app connectivity is smooth and the fingerprint sensor responds quickly. Battery life seems excellent so far, with no signs of draining fast. The keypad backlight is a nice touch for night use. Overall, great value for the price.

reviews.author: Lohith N
reviews.title: Free from keys!
reviews.body: Delivery was prompt. Installation took time and was dusty but was done neatly. Have been using it from >15 days and I would say it's made my life easy one (key less) at a time! Pros: No need to carry keys, no need to ask someone at home to lock the door when going out as it automatically locks. Camera unlocks even if it's dark. Battery is at 70% even after >15 days. Good job UC. Product price is at a higher end but worth. Cons: Mine was a heavy Honne wood door and sometimes the door gets stuck (mostly due to weather changes) instead of opening but it's the door and not the lock.
